items.criterion: The public article list carries published records only, ordered newest first.
items.judgment: Read the article list and confirm the draft slug is absent and the publication stamps descend.

items.criterion: A draft article is refused to a reader session and to the second author, and answered to its own author.
items.judgment: Request the draft slug from each session and compare the outcomes.

items.criterion: A draft cover is refused to every session but its author's.
items.judgment: Request the draft cover from the anonymous, reader and second-author sessions.

items.criterion: The cover object exists in the bucket at the pinned key scheme and the row carries the key.
items.judgment: Read the article row and head the object at the recorded key.

items.criterion: Exactly one article row carries featured true after two simultaneous featuring requests.
items.judgment: Issue both requests together and count the featured rows.

items.criterion: The attachment upload grant is a signed object-store URL carrying the pinned lifetime.
items.judgment: Request a grant and inspect the returned URL and lifetime.

items.criterion: The build request is stored with its submitted prompt before the response is sent.
items.judgment: Submit a prompt and read the build request row by the returned identifier.

items.criterion: A reader session is refused every authoring endpoint and the protected rows are unchanged.
items.judgment: Call the authoring endpoint from a reader session and count the rows before and after.

items.criterion: The question set is served as structured data ordered by group then position.
items.judgment: Read the question route and confirm the ordering keys ascend.

items.criterion: A known subscription address and a fresh one produce the same response.
items.judgment: Submit both and compare status and body.

items.criterion: The seven public routes render their named sections in the supplied order at the three captured widths.
items.judgment: Open each route at each width and compare against the supplied composition list.
